cap.tr: Deque (double-ended queue) iki uçtan da ekleme ve çıkarmaya izin verir. Yığın ve kuyruğun birleşimi gibidir.
cap.en: A deque (double-ended queue) allows adding and removing at both ends. It is like a stack and a queue combined.

cap.en: `pop_front()`: 1 at the front left (like a queue). All four operations are O(1); implemented with a circular array or a doubly linked list.
